description: MTA Bus Stops is a dataset listed in State of Maryland open data portal (opendata.maryland.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Maryland. Maryland Transit Administration Winter 2026 Bus Stops (CityLink, LocalLink, QuickLink, Express BusLink & Commuter Bus). Includes Summer 2024 mean daily weekday stop ridership. Coverage: Maryland. Its tags are quicklink express, maryland transit, maryland open data, maryland, express buslink. The table has 13 columns. The portal shows 2026-04-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-maryland-gov-portal.
